changelog: Maintenance console: when the platform **SuperAdmin** signs in, the dashboard opens with a technical card (“Benvenuto Socly SuperAdmin”) showing who is connected, when the session started, the previous sign-in and the…

Bank-statement import: Intesa Sanpaolo “Operazioni di conto” / Lista movimenti model (signed single IMPORTO column; separate from the Conto Business Insieme estratto). Large Lista movimenti PDFs no longer re-OCR every…

Resource busy lock: while an operator runs a heavy job (bank-statement anomaly check / excerpt repair, or an in-app update), other users and other browser tabs see a pause message with that person’s name until the job…

Login greeting: the sign-in card now reads “Buongiorno / Buon pomeriggio / Buonasera <nome>” with “Bentornato/a” under it (from the operator profile) instead of the generic “Accesso / Sto entrando…” copy.
Operator accounts now collect gender (required, used for the welcome greeting) and an optional birth date, in the admin user editor, the inline Settings form and the setup wizard.
Bank-statement “check all statements”: if a full audit finished less than an hour ago, the operator can reopen those results instead of re-running OCR on every PDF.
Bank-statement verify: bulk “fix all dates / amounts” with confirm, count and ETA; ledger-only rows without a covering archived statement are listed as ignored (not actionable).
Session idle timeout no longer logs anyone out in the middle of a heavy job (statement audit, excerpt repair, in-app update): the holder’s session stays alive until the job ends.
Resource-busy pause shows the operation name first and “Started by … at …”, and hard-unlocks the instance after at most 30 minutes.
Documents: Estratti Conto list newest reference period first (year, then month).
Document repository: `annotate()` can update `original_name` so downloads match the archive title.
